Package restaurantrush.control

Class Game

java.lang.Object
restaurantrush.control.Game
public class Game extends Object
Handles the game rules for each turn. There is no input/output code here. The controller passes in the manager's choices as numbers, and this class checks them, updates the restaurant and saves messages about what happened.
